name: RDP brute force from a known scanner
story: A known malicious scanner makes 46 failed sign-in attempts against the jump server. Nothing succeeded. The agent blocks the IP and puts a medium-severity ticket in the queue.

incident.title: Multiple failed RDP sign-ins from an external IP
incident.description: 46 failed logons against SRV-JUMP-01 from a single public IP address within 30 minutes.
